start
Hi, I'm demonstrating Canopy Compare, an offline browser tool I built to review ecological forecast flags directly against dated PhenoCam photographs and export traceable review logs.
settings
Here we're replaying the May 8, 2025 greenness forecast across 14 NEON sites. The queue ranks cameras using a conservative change score with a threshold of zero point zero one zero.
spring
Steigerwaldt in Wisconsin comes out on top. Even after subtracting historical forecast uncertainty, the model still expects a strong spring green-up over the next week.
pictures
When I open Compare images, the May 6 and May 15 archive photos appear side by side. On May 6 the canopy is still mostly bare; by May 15, fresh green leaves fill the view.
region

I can also overlay the official PhenoCam sampling mask in gold. Across 197 verified frames, pixels inside this mask reproduce the published midday color averages, so we know we are inspecting the exact measured canopy.
mark
Notice that the ground-truth numbers stay hidden while I inspect the photos. I'll mark this as a visible color change, which saves locally on this device.
reveal
Now let's reveal the later observations. The greenness index actually climbed to zero point four four six, roughly double the rise our model predicted from baseline.
export
Clicking Export review log downloads a CSV containing my visual note, the model forecast, the observed index, and direct links to both original archive photos.
fall
Autumn redness is much trickier. Switching to the October 9 replay and the redness channel puts Treehaven first, where the model predicted a sharp drop.
fall_reveal
But when we reveal the October 16 record, redness actually ticked up slightly. Showing misses in direction clearly helps analysts catch where the forecast failed.
fall_pair
Opening the image pair gives immediate visual context. Because snow, glare, or slight camera shifts can move daily color indices, human inspection stays essential before labeling an event.
fallback

The interface also handles edge cases cleanly. Entering an unsupported date triggers an explicit explanation without erasing any saved review marks, and clicking the recovery button restores the valid archive week.
evidence

Over in Model evidence, a 74-issue historical benchmark shows our uncertainty-discounted ranking found more spring green-up shifts than a recent-trend baseline, while trading off a few autumn red hits.
model

Under the hood, gradient-boosted trees correct seasonal baselines locally on CPU and beat both persistence and seasonal references across 2024 through 2026. Everything you just saw runs offline from index.html with no API keys required.
